title: HomeOps Diagnostic Pack (dkm-v1)
description: Validated, signed bundle of Diagnostic Knowledge Model (DKM) records for one appliance model or family. Generated by the extraction pipeline, validated before publish, signed by the pack server, and verified on-device before use.

pack_version.description: Semver of the pack content. Bumped whenever any record in the pack changes.

schema.description: Ties the pack to the DKM schema version.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 hex over the canonical JSON serialization. Server-set at publish time; NOT included in the data that is hashed.

ed25519_sig.description: Server Ed25519 signature over content_hash. Server-set at publish time. Clients verify before swapping in a downloaded pack.

model_number.description: Model number as printed on the appliance / matched in model_registry. Example: WM3700HWA

family.description: Platform/family the model belongs to. Example: WM3700H*A. May be the model_number for unique models.

source_docs.description: Source manual(s) this pack was derived from (corpus filenames). One pack may draw from several docs.

source_pages.description: Page/section map: section name -> page range or label. Example: {"error_codes": "21-27"}

extraction_method.description: Which extraction channel produced the records (A=tables, B=prose, C=flowcharts, manual=hand-built).

license_tag.description: OQ-02 posture tag. Example: manufacturer-copyright (derived/synthesized — see OQ-02)

copyright_notice.description: Copyright notice retained verbatim from the source. Never stripped.

error_codes.description: Error/fault codes for this model. Error-code lookup is the #1 diagnostic use case — precision matters.

code.description: The code as displayed on the appliance. Example: LE

name.description: Short human name. Example: Locked Motor Error

likely_cause.description: Likely root causes, from the manual.

model_scope.description: Model numbers this code applies to. Omitted = this pack's model/family only.

source.description: Section/page reference in the source manual. Example: Troubleshooting With Error p23

symptoms.description: Canonical symptom phrases with natural-language variants, each routing to a procedure.

canonical.description: Canonical symptom phrase. Example: won't drain

variants.description: User-phrased variants. Example: water stays in drum

procedure_ref.description: Procedure id this symptom routes to.

model_scope.description: Models this symptom applies to. Omitted = this pack's model/family only.

procedures.description: Ordered diagnostic procedures (decision sequences) for this model.

entry_symptom.description: Canonical symptom that enters this procedure.

safety_level.description: Highest level across steps; used to gate consumer visibility.

exit_conditions.description: Conditions under which the procedure terminates (e.g. fault cleared, replaced part).

model_scope.description: Models this procedure applies to. Omitted = this pack's model/family only.

source.description: Section/page reference in the source manual.

parts.description: Part references for the technician handoff.

ref.description: Part reference as printed in the manual/parts list. Example: PRESSURE SWITCH

when.description: When this part is implicated. Example: PE + resistance out of 21-23 ohm

safety_rules.description: Per-model safety rules. Gas vs electric variants differ — always per-pack.

references.description: Cross-pack references (pack_ids) for multi-model conflicts and family relationships. Empty array is valid.

safetyLevel.description: 1 = consumer-safe action. 2 = requires a tool. 3 = requires power-off / qualified handling (gas, high-voltage, refrigerant). 4 = technician-only. POLICY (OQ-22, 2026-08-16): all levels are viewable by consumers; steps at levels 3-4 display an explicit warning before execution.

action.description: What to do / check. Example: Measure stator resistance U-V, V-W, W-V.

observation.description: What to observe / expected condition. Example: Expect 5-15 ohm.

expected_value.description: Exact expected value where the manual specifies one. Example: 21-23 ohm +/-10%

pass_branch.description: Next step id or terminal action when the check passes. Omitted = proceed to next step.

fail_branch.description: Next step id or terminal action when the check fails. Example: STOP: level 3 — call a pro.

warning.description: Warning text to display BEFORE this step executes. REQUIRED when safety_level >= 3 (OQ-22: all levels viewable, warnings when needed). Example: ⚠️ Disconnect power before testing.
